//: The engine wasm's split modules (docs/web-export.md §Modules): each module takes the functions whose demangled path, from its first non-std crate on, matches one of its patterns; the first module that matches wins. scripts/wasm-split.ts keeps in the primary every function a game using none of them runs (wasm-profile.ts) and every function `roots` reach up to `entries`, so such a game loads none.
//roots: The engine's calls every game makes whatever it uses (scripts/wasm-split.ts framePath): a frame, a canvas attach, a geometry. Every function they reach by direct calls stays in the primary, stopping at `entries`.
//entries: The calls those make into a module only once the game uses it, each guarded in og-runtime (names without crate hashes): og.motion once og.MotionAgent is registered (engine/tick.rs render); set_mesh for a dynamic geometry's update, a streamed model's proxy and a destructible's hulls (generated geometry goes to physics' mesh source, bind/modules.rs note_mesh); the physics debug view; a video's stream once a video plays.
